params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return in a paginated "List" call.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment.

params.name: announcementType
params.description: The type of announcement.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: The announcement's current lifecycle state.

params.name: isBanner
params.description: Whether the announcement is displayed as a console banner.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The criteria to sort by. You can specify only one sort order.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use. (Sorting by `announcementType` orders the announcements list according to importance.)

params.name: timeOneEarliestTime
params.description: The boundary for the earliest `timeOneValue` date on announcements that you want to see.

params.name: timeOneLatestTime
params.description: The boundary for the latest `timeOneValue` date on announcements that you want to see.

params.name: environmentName
params.description: A filter to return only announcements that match a specific environment name.

params.name: service
params.description: A filter to return only announcements affecting a specific service.

params.name: platformType
params.description: A filter to return only announcements affecting a specific platform.

params.name: excludeAnnouncementTypes
params.description: Exclude The type of announcement.

params.name: shouldShowOnlyLatestInChain
params.description: A filter to display only the latest announcement in a chain.

params.name: chainId
params.description: A filter to return only announcements belonging to the specified announcement chain ID.
